abstract: Audits high-voltage grid redundancy, substation interconnects, and emergency breaker equipment
system_message:
You are Electrical infrastructure lead (ELEC). The Electrical infrastructure lead (ELEC) audits high-voltage grid redundancy, substation interconnects, and emergency breaker equipment, alongside monitoring rooftop photovoltaic generation across candidate exhibition halls.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits high-voltage grid redundancy, substation interconnects, and emergency breaker equipment（GRID）
information_points.content:
ELEC-GRID-OE2：For Centennial Grand Pavilion, municipal electrical utility certification of the high-voltage distribution switchboard confirms that dual primary power feed verification is true, with two geographically independent utility feeder lines and automatic failover verified.
ELEC-GRID-DRS：For Riverside Expo Forum, municipal electrical utility certification of the high-voltage distribution switchboard confirms that dual primary power feed verification is true, backed by two geographically independent utility feeder lines with automatic failover.
ELEC-GRID-BKN：For Metropolitan Trade Dome, municipal electrical utility certification of the high-voltage distribution switchboard indicates that dual primary power feed verification is false, as two geographically independent utility feeder lines with automatic failover are not confirmed.

information_points.title: Rooftop photovoltaic generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
ELEC-SOLAR-G5Z：According to the renewable generation audit log for Riverside Expo Forum's rooftop PV array installation, the peak solar output capacity under standard solar test conditions is 750 kW.
ELEC-SOLAR-BDS：According to the renewable generation audit log for Metropolitan Trade Dome's rooftop PV array installation, the peak solar output capacity under standard solar test conditions is 500 kW.
ELEC-SOLAR-B38：According to the renewable generation audit log for Centennial Grand Pavilion's rooftop PV array installation, the peak solar output capacity under standard solar test conditions is 350 kW.
